entries.name: Page coherence is the supreme brand law
entries.principle: a brand is not a logo — it is *recognition at a glance*. Every piece must read as one family (structure, color tonality, fonts) with the live page.
entries.instruction: before any asset ships, run the page-identity conformance check (the 8-check gate: dark bg, red border, giant centered headline, pill, footer, masthead, forbidden-color scan, dead-space cap). A failing piece is a defect, never "a different style."

entries.name: The cover grammar is a parts list, not a mood
entries.principle: reproducibility beats inspiration — when the spec names exact parts (thin red border ~4px, pill kicker near top, giant centered white headline 150–220px on 1080 canvas, one red accent word, gray meta, @369VIDEONEWS footer, no dead voids), any builder produces on-brand work without taste-guessing.
entries.instruction: encode every visual standard as a measured parts list with tolerances, never as adjectives.

entries.name: The live page beats the art bible
entries.principle: ground truth is observed, not designed — the spec was built from a read-only pull of the live grid (5/5 posts inspected, color-sampled). When a designed identity conflicts with the live artifact, the live artifact wins and the bible rebases.
entries.instruction: re-audit identity specs from live artifacts on a schedule; never let memory or intention override observation.

entries.name: Coherence lives in structure, colors rotate
entries.principle: the skeleton is fixed (5 immutable elements — hook cover, system slides, HEX-in-pill, funnel CTA closer, type lock); ONLY colors rotate through curated combos. This gives freshness without chaos — the audience recognizes the family while never seeing the same thing twice.
entries.instruction: fix structure, rotate surface; anchor-first (red/black/white default), mood-match the combo to the story, series-lock one combo per serial, never repeat a combo within 4 pieces, contrast is law.

entries.instruction: when auditing, tag every deviation as canon or accident; never enshrine accidents.

entries.principle: at thumbnail scale only the largest, highest-contrast mass survives — one word is the largest possible semantic mass; faces pop out pre-attentively (Hershler & Hochstein).
entries.instruction: covers = 2–5 words max, one saturated accent, squint-test at 246px, face big and close when the story has one.

entries.instruction: one focal point + negative space; clutter lowers attention (Pieters).

entries.instruction: one camera move per AI clip; a script demanding three simultaneous moves is a bad script.

entries.name: Retention-curve troubleshooting
entries.principle: the curve's shape names the fix — cliff at 1–3s = hook failed (rewrite the opening, not the middle); slow slide = loose pacing (cut, insert cutaways); drop at a beat = remove that beat; good hook + weak completion = fix the last 2 seconds first.
entries.instruction: diagnose from the curve, never guess.

entries.instruction: every item passes ALL gates; a gate without a live caller is retired (wire-or-retire).
